correctness.rationale: The proof fixes all quantifiers and definitions. Transitive subsets of C3[R_n] meet at most two blocks, giving the exact union of three pairwise joins. The two homotopy-pushout steps use cofibration inclusions and null end-inclusions of joins; the disconnected second intersection contributes exactly one S^1. Govc's inspected cyclic case supplies dFl(R_n)≃S^1. Independent finite reconstructions at n=3 and n=5 verify regularity, non-double-regularity, the join decomposition, and the predicted Betti vector; these checks are corroboration, not the universal proof.

originality.rationale: The closest primary full text classifies all regular tournaments only through order 13 and doubly regular tournaments through order 27. The new family is non-doubly-regular, and its n>=5 tail begins at order 15. Exact published-finding corpus and web searches under composition/substitution/lexicographic aliases found no statement implying the all-parameter result. The n=3/order-9 special case is explicitly acknowledged as covered rather than counted as novel.
residual_risks: Tournament substitution may appear in non-indexed literature under modular decomposition or composition terminology without mentioning directed flag complexes.
Govc's published finite census covers the order-9 member; originality is only claimed for the structural all-parameter theorem and its tail beyond order 13.

value.rationale: This is not an arbitrary finite invariant: it gives a uniform homotopy classification for an infinite, naturally defined family of regular tournaments immediately beyond the published regular census, and explains why the unusual mixed wedge S^1∨3S^2∨3S^3 recurs.
